record.question: Answer any three (3) of the following: (a) What is the duty of a Government servant in relation to involvement of members of his family in politics. (b) A Government servant displays electoral symbol of a particular party on his vehicle and house. How would you deal with this as per Rule 7 of the CCS(Conduct) Rules, 1964? (c) What do you mean by 'Strike' within the meaning of the CCS(Conduct) Rules, 1964? (d) Mention any two conducts which a Government servant shall maintain in regard consumption of intoxicating drinks and drugs. (e) Define 'Public Place' within the meaning of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964.
